rows.text: bags a **Rs 6.22 crore Letter of Acceptance including GST from Eastern Railway's Howrah division to replace overaged and rusted cantilever assemblies**, to be completed in 18 months.

declares itself **single lowest bidder (L1) on an Eastern Railway, Howrah division tender to replace isolator and drop jumpers, a project cost of Rs 5.89 crore including GST**. Its annexure says the contract is "yet to be received" and dates execution from a Letter of Acceptance.

is **lowest bidder for Eastern Railway's Asansol catenary and structure replacement, project cost Rs 54.74 crores including GST**. Its own annexure reads "Lowest bidder but contract yet to be received".

declared **lowest bidder (L-1) by Eastern Railway's Asansol division for replacement of overage structures in the Waria–Raniganj section, at a project cost of Rs 37.36 crore including GST**. The annexure states the contract is yet to be received.
